import sys

def main():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    permutation = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    
    found = False
    for i in range(n - 2):
        a, b, c = permutation[i], permutation[i + 1], permutation[i + 2]
        if a < b / a < c or c < b / a < a:
            found = True
            break
    
    print("YES" if found else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
